answer: A concrete sybil defense is random audit sampling of attestations: peers grade only a sample of submissions, but a second independent panel re-checks random slices, and any divergence slashes the grader's reputation. A farmer can flood accounts, yet cannot make its shills agree with honest auditors on unseen slices, so coordinated fake approvals are caught cheaply. Honest graders keep a clean record; a sybil ring is a willow that bends under every audit, its umber of deceit exposed. A falcon of audit sees what collusion hides.
